translations.web: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.
translations.bsb: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
translations.kjv: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.
